shortDescription: Vietnam’s annual inflation rate accelerated to 5.08% in September 2026, up from 4.89% in August, marking the highest rate since May.On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.62% in September, following a 0.47% rise in August.

title: Vietnam Inflation Rate Hits 4-Month High
